description: This file defines the FileAccessControlHandler class for managing access permissions to file entities in Drupal, including methods for checking access for operations like view, download, update, delete, and managing field-level permissions.

classes.name: FileAccessControlHandler
classes.description: A class that handles access control for file entities in Drupal, implementing permission checks for viewing, downloading, updating, deleting, and field access.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to perform a specific operation (view, download, update, delete) on a file entity.

methods.name: getFileReferences
methods.description: Retrieves references to the file from other entities.

methods.name: checkFieldAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for specific fields of the file entity, such as 'uri', 'filemime', 'filesize', and 'status'.

methods.name: checkCreateAccess
methods.description: Determines if a user has permission to create a new file entity.
